_A_CALENDAR_COMPONENT_DESCRIPTION_: The ACalendar component shows a month or a week with events, like Outlook. Events can last several days and have a color. The names of the months and weekdays come from the current language. The component does not create events: open your own form on the events day-click and time-click.
_A_CALENDAR_BASIC_DESCRIPTION_: events is an array of objects with label, start and end. v-model is the selected day as "YYYY-MM-DD". The arrow keys move between the days, Page Up and Page Down change the month.
_A_CALENDAR_MULTI_DAY_DESCRIPTION_: An event from start to end is a bar over several days and continues in the next week or month. end is the last day of the event. color is a color of the theme (primary, secondary, tertiary, success, info, warning, danger, gray) or any CSS color. Events with isAllDay have no time. max-events-per-day="0" shows all events.
_A_CALENDAR_WEEK_DESCRIPTION_: view="week" shows a week with the hours, the buttons Month and Week switch the view (v-model:view). Events with a time lie in the time grid, overlapping events share the width of the day. All-day events and events over several days are bars above the hours. hourStart and hourEnd limit the hours, scrollToHour is the hour visible at the top. views sets the views of the switch.
_A_CALENDAR_MAX_EVENTS_DESCRIPTION_: maxEventsPerDay limits the events shown in a day (3 by default). The others are counted in a button +N, which emits the event more-click with all events of the day.
_A_CALENDAR_SLOTS_DESCRIPTION_: The slot header replaces the title and the buttons, day the day number and event the content of an event.
_A_CALENDAR_CREATE_DESCRIPTION_: The form is not part of the component. Here a click on a day opens AModalForm to create an event, in the week view a click on a time opens it with this time (time-click). A click on an event opens it for editing or deleting. The button Delete is added with the slot modalFooterAppend.
_A_CALENDAR_CREATE_DELETE_CONFIRM_BODY_{: Do you want to delete the event {{label}}?
_A_CALENDAR_PROPS_COLOR_DEFAULT_: The color of events without a color.
_A_CALENDAR_PROPS_EVENTS_: The events. An event without a valid start is ignored.
_A_CALENDAR_PROPS_FIRST_DAY_OF_WEEK_: The first day of the week: 0 is Sunday, 1 is Monday. The default comes from ADatepickerPlugin.
_A_CALENDAR_PROPS_HOUR_END_: Week view: the hour where the time grid ends (1 to 24).
_A_CALENDAR_PROPS_HOUR_START_: Week view: the hour where the time grid starts (0 to 23).
_A_CALENDAR_PROPS_ID_: The id of the component. The title has the id {id}_title.
_A_CALENDAR_PROPS_KEY_COLOR_: The key (or a function) of the color of an event.
_A_CALENDAR_PROPS_KEY_END_: The key (or a function) of the end of an event. The end is the last day of the event. Without an end the event lasts one day.
_A_CALENDAR_PROPS_KEY_ID_: The key (or a function) of the id of an event.
_A_CALENDAR_PROPS_KEY_IS_ALL_DAY_: The key (or a function) for events without a time.
_A_CALENDAR_PROPS_KEY_LABEL_: The key (or a function) of the title of an event.
_A_CALENDAR_PROPS_KEY_START_: The key (or a function) of the start of an event: a Date, a timestamp or a string like "2026-03-10" or "2026-03-10T09:00:00".
_A_CALENDAR_PROPS_MAX_EVENTS_PER_DAY_: The maximum number of events shown in a day. 0 shows all events.
_A_CALENDAR_PROPS_MODEL_VALUE_: The selected day. The calendar shows its month or week.
_A_CALENDAR_PROPS_SCROLL_TO_HOUR_: Week view: the hour visible at the top of the time grid.
_A_CALENDAR_PROPS_TIME_STEP_: Week view: the minutes to which the start of time-click is rounded.
_A_CALENDAR_PROPS_VIEWS_: The views of the switch in the header. With one view the switch is hidden.
_A_CALENDAR_EVENTS_DAY_CLICK_: A click on a day: { date, events, $event }.
_A_CALENDAR_EVENTS_EVENT_CLICK_: A click on an event: { event, start, end, $event }.
_A_CALENDAR_EVENTS_RANGE_CHANGE_: The shown days have changed (also when the calendar is mounted): { start, end, month, view }. Load the events of these days here.
_A_CALENDAR_EVENTS_TIME_CLICK_: Week view, a click on an empty place of the time grid: { date, start, end, $event }. end is start plus timeStep.
_A_CALENDAR_SLOT_DAY_: The content of a day: { day, events }.
_A_CALENDAR_SLOT_EVENT_: The content of an event: { event, start, end, isStart, isEnd }. isStart and isEnd are false if the bar continues in another week.
_A_CALENDAR_SLOT_HEADER_: The header: { title, range, view, views, changeView, goToPrevious, goToNext, goToToday }.
_A_CALENDAR_EXPOSES_FOCUS_DAY_: Focuses a day ("YYYY-MM-DD") and shows its month.
_A_CALENDAR_EXPOSES_GO_TO_DATE_: Shows the month of a date.
_A_CALENDAR_EXPOSES_GO_TO_NEXT_: Shows the next month or week.
_A_CALENDAR_EXPOSES_GO_TO_NEXT_MONTH_: The same as goToNext (the name of the first version).
_A_CALENDAR_EXPOSES_GO_TO_PREVIOUS_: Shows the previous month or week.
_A_CALENDAR_EXPOSES_GO_TO_PREVIOUS_MONTH: The same as goToPrevious (the name of the first version).
